payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute Fibonacci numbers with 1D DP (a[i] = a[i-1] + a[i-2]) for lengths n and m, then combine as 2*(a[n]+b[m]-1) modulo 10^9+7.
payload.rationale: The DP uses a single dimension (index i) to compute a recurrence, characteristic of dp_1d_state. The counting is achieved via a closed-form combination, not by combinatorial DP transitions.
